class: Composite widget fragments become unrelated questions
symptom: The phone wrapper was treated as another textbox and the inner number was named +1; AI answered 6 years. Consent was named for more details instead of its question.
root_cause: Nested textbox roles were not collapsed, dial-code text replaced the phone heading, and linked paragraph fragments replaced the consent question.
why_tests_missed: Fixtures did not combine a textbox wrapper, dial button, child input, and a consent paragraph containing links with adjacent paragraph radio labels.
fix: Keep the actual child textbox with its phone heading, ignore the dial-code as a label, and preserve the paragraph question across links while reading adjacent radio captions.
prevention: Assert the final question identities and offered radio labels for composite widgets before profile or AI answering.
